_purpose: All WhatsApp bot cost inputs, spend caps, rate limits, and kill-switch thresholds in ONE editable file. Change a number here to re-model or to retune the guardrails; no code change needed.
_verify_before_launch: Rates below are from secondary sources (Sep 2026). Meta promised the exact 1-Oct-2026 rate card by 1 Sep 2026 - PIN these to the official Meta developer pricing page before go-live. See UNVERIFIED.md #17.
fx_note: USD figures in COST_MODEL.md use ~₹87/USD (approx, 2026). Verify at launch.

service_message.conflict: Some sources say 0.145. Pin to official Meta rate card.
service_message.note: Free-form reply in the open 24h window. THIS is our main cost line.

utility_template.note: Needed to reply OUTSIDE the 24h window (re-engagement).

authentication_template.note: Not used by this bot (no OTP/login).

marketing_template.note: NEVER used. No ads, no marketing - constraint #10.

service_messages_free_per_number_per_mon.note: Charges apply only from the 1,001st service message that month.

free_entry_point_window_hours.applies_to: Click-to-WhatsApp ads / FB Page CTA only
free_entry_point_window_hours.note: wa.me deep links do NOT qualify - our conversations are ordinary user-initiated service windows.

llm_cost_estimate._note: A small, cheap, CONFIGURABLE model used only for phrasing + intent parsing - never for factual content. Cost is separate from Meta message cost. Placeholder pending the chosen model's real token price.

share_of_messages_using_llm.note: Target: 70%+ answered from cache/canned with NO LLM call (brief). This saves LLM cost, NOT Meta cost.

avg_inr_per_llm_message.confidence: placeholder - replace with real per-token cost of the chosen model

avg_messages_per_conversation.note: Batched: each answer is ONE message (constraint). Assume initial answer + occasional single follow-up. Estimate - flag.

per_number_rate_limit.on_exceed: Serve one cached 'you have reached today's limit - here is the helpline' reply, then stop replying to that number until reset (an un-sent reply incurs no Meta charge).

global_daily_spend_cap_inr.note: Hard ceiling on a day's total Meta+LLM spend. Tune to budget. At ~₹0.19/conversation this is ~26,000 conversations/day.

kill_switch.manual_override: A single boolean an operator can flip to force hard-kill immediately.
kill_switch.soft_kill_behavior: Disable LLM calls (serve cache/canned only) and disable follow-up messages (one reply per conversation max). Cuts LLM cost and halves Meta cost.
kill_switch.hard_kill_behavior: Stop sending any replies. Webhook still 200s so Meta does not retry; no reply = no Meta charge. Log every dropped message for later reconciliation.
kill_switch.note: Because every reply is billable, the ONLY real Meta-cost lever is the NUMBER of replies sent. Both kill tiers reduce replies.

logging.privacy: Store a salted hash of the phone number, not the raw number, in cost logs. Raw number lives only in the session store per the DPDP privacy design (D7).
